A clean beat on every line and the first mid-year guidance upgrade in 15 years: derived Q2 operating profit of ¥66.0bn (~$418m) was ~32% above the ~¥50bn market expectation and FY3/27 OP guidance moved from ¥143bn to ¥193bn (~$1.22bn), with 100% of the raise coming from Digital Entertainment (eFootball's World Cup window plus Yu-Gi-Oh! card demand). The debate now is durability, not delivery: management's own H2 implies DE business profit falling 25% from H1, Gaming & Systems guidance was left stale, and the equity's ~26x forward multiple rests on one live-service franchise holding a tournament-year cohort into a quadrennial comp.

PhilWeb Corporation

A clean, if small, print: Q3-26 revenue +152.9% YoY to P443.0m (~$6.9m), EBITDA P68.4m (~$1.1m) at a 15.4% margin and a third straight profitable quarter (net income P64.2m / ~$1.0m vs a P19.2m loss), all driven by the B2B Digital Solutions segment, which grew 40.5% QoQ to P281.3m (~$4.4m) and is now 63.5% of the mix. The balance sheet has been rebuilt by Lance Gokongwei's P2.03bn (~$31.6m) injection (equity swung from a P254.5m deficit to +P1.895bn / ~$29.5m; cash P2.22bn / ~$34.6m), but the P4.23bn (~$65.9m) JKS Tech cross-investment commitment exceeds that cash and the legacy venue business is still shrinking (-7.7% YoY), so this is an early-stage platform story priced on partner-GGR ramp rather than a proven margin structure.

Codere Group

A profitability quarter, not a growth quarter: group gross win rose just 6% to €344m (~$380m) but adj. EBITDA jumped 39% to €65.4m (~$72m), lifting margin ~450bps to 19.0%, with Retail (+32% to €54.0m on Mexico cost actions, Argentina and Spain) and Online (group-basis €11.3m vs €6.2m) both contributing and LTM retail EBITDA rising for an eighth straight quarter to €210.7m (~$233m).
